note: The rclpy half of the wrapper case. There is no create_publisher and no create_subscription in this module, yet it publishes /diagnostics and subscribes to two point cloud topics. The executable is px_health while the module is wrappers_node, so the join key from a launch file is the console_scripts entry point and never the module name. line_hint is advisory and never compared.
